Team —

Quick, tactical ask as we head into close of week: finance needs the final set of updated numbers and stage-clearance notes by 10:00 PT today so we can reconcile ARR variance and feed the pack to execs. Please do the following before 10:00 PT: 

- Paste latest ARR/TCV rows into the shared sheet (link below) using the "weekly_numbers_template_v3.xlsx" format.
- Confirm stage for any deals older than 60 days or flagged as "stalled"; add one-line rationale in the Stage Notes column.
- Mark any deals you want to keep as commit (flag = COMMIT) with expected close date.

I've attached the template and a short agenda for the 11:00 PT sync where we'll run a 20-min gate review followed by Q/A. Join link: (agenda in attachment). If you cannot meet the 10:00 cutoff, reply with a quick ETA — we may push the intake window to 10:30 but would like to avoid that if possible.

Sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2b3c-numbers-blitz
Attachment: weekly_numbers_template_v3.xlsx (xlsx), 11am-sync-agenda.pdf (pdf)

Why this matters: finance is juggling an ARR reconciliation and the CFO requested a cleaned commit list by EOD for the board pack. We keep missing a small set of late changes that materially affect the wire numbers. This is the last clean pass.

Thanks — see you on the call.

Laura
